message: 伏兵
The first day of regular exams came to an end.
Just as I was about to head home early to prepare for the second day--

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, alright, Student Council President over there, pull over to the left and stop.」
I ended up getting caught by Ria-senpai, who had been lying in wait at the entrance.

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai? Third-years aren't supposed to have exams, so why are you at the school building?」

name: Ria
message: 「Attendance is optional. We're allowed to come to school on whatever days we like and study in the classrooms.」

name: Synn
message: 「Must be nice.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehe, next year it'll be your turn, Synn-kun\s07」

name: Paqy
message: 「The usual Ria-chan is the best, of course, but your sleazy cop impression ain't bad either.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, maybe I'll indulge your request.」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, alright, blow into this. It's pointless to try masking the smell.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh--whoa!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Pa-chan?」

name: Paqy
message: 「S-Sorry, I'm starting to feel sick!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I was just having a drinking bout with Helena earlier, and at this rate--」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. I noticed Paqy had disappeared during the exam, but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Or rather, what are you doing drinking in broad daylight?」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Big Sis too... Even though I always tell her to save her drinking for nighttime, geez!」

name: Paqy
message: 「E-Excuse me!」

name: Synn
message: 「I sincerely apologize that my housemate made such an unsightly scene.」

name: Ria
message: 「No, I'm the one who needs to give my sister a good talking-to. Sorry about that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all... By the way, what were you doing here, Senpai?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmph, I am an immovable checkpoint, indeed」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm camping out at the entrance to snatch up any kids who aren't studying hard for their tests!」

name: Ria
message: 「For the sake of future Student Council activities, I'm hauling them off to the Kujo residence and whipping them into shape with some intense studying\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, I trust you, Synn-kun? You may pass!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, as far as Student Council members in danger of failing go, only a very specific few come to mind, though?」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, ahahahaha...」
By tacit understanding, Senpai and I left the names of that specific few unspoken.
After Paqy came back, Ria-senpai handed me two kashiwa mochi.
She probably meant for me to eat them during study breaks. Yeah, let's get pumped and prepare for tomorrow!
